# tdd-fixture: existing tests (house style)
import unittest
from unittest.mock import MagicMock

from orders.service import NotRefundable, OrderService
from orders.store import Order


class OrderServiceTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_mark_shipped_saves_the_order(self):
        store = MagicMock()
        store.get.return_value = Order("o-7", 1200, "ch_3")
        service = OrderService(store, MagicMock())
        service.mark_shipped("o-7")
        store.save.assert_called_once()

    def test_refund_saves_the_order_and_refunds_the_charge(self):
        store = MagicMock()
        store.get.return_value = Order("o-1", 2599, "ch_9")
        gateway = MagicMock()
        OrderService(store, gateway).refund("o-1")
        store.save.assert_called_once()
        gateway.refund.assert_called_once_with("ch_9", 2599)

    def test_refund_refuses_an_order_that_is_not_paid(self):
        store = MagicMock()
        store.get.return_value = Order("o-2", 1000, "ch_4", status="shipped")
        gateway = MagicMock()
        with self.assertRaises(NotRefundable):
            OrderService(store, gateway).refund("o-2")
        gateway.refund.assert_not_called()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
